title: Bivariate range functions with superior convergence order
summary: Range functions are a fundamental tool for certified computations in geometric modeling, computer graphics, and robotics, but traditional range functions have only quadratic convergence order ($m=2$). For ``superior'' convergence order (i.e., $m>2$), we exploit the Cornelius--Lohner framework in order to introduce new bivariate range functions based on Taylor, Lagrange, and Hermite interpolation.
